contracts.title: Submission guards and preparation
contracts.claim: Put collects editor text/persistedText, mentions and attachments; it rejects empty or blocked/stale submission paths, prepares context and references, and switches targets by kind. Its local.submit argument positions carry context,cwd,execution options,restore message,client message ID,queue overrides and onMessageAdded.

contracts.title: Local acceptance does not mean turn completion
contracts.claim: Put uses onMessageAdded locallyAccepted/requestDispatched to release UI submission state and clear or retain draft/history; submitted/queued results have their own callbacks. It does not treat these UI callbacks as turn/completed notifications.

contracts.title: Draft and delivery failure ownership
contracts.claim: Put distinguishes queued/sent, first-turn creation-outcome-unknown/rejected/not-started and delivery-not-sent/outcome-unknown. AbortError bypasses ordinary reporting; finally and restore/retain callbacks follow ownership/current-submission checks. No persisted turn result is inferred from editor clearing.

contracts.title: Zut UI submission ownership
contracts.claim: Zut guards reentrant submission and policy/account/current target changes, sets UI submitting state, manages deferred attachments and retained draft recovery, and cleans watchers/finally state. These are renderer submission controls, separate from manager active-turn state. Only static code was read; no real account values were inspected.

contracts.title: Adapter branch and uncertain creation
contracts.claim: _9e handleSubmitLocal prepares context then selects existing local follow-up, cloud follow-up, or new creation paths. Pending/unknown first-turn creation is returned as unknown rather than blindly resent; errors restore pending presentation unless outcome remains unknown. Worktree has a separate callback.
